meta.note: Tokens synced from tcdw/koi and extended into a general system; components are hand-written, not from the repository.

palettes.note: A palette swaps the primary-* and accent-* scales; every role that points at them follows, in both themes. The other scales (secondary, warning, error) are fixed. Apps can also pass their own palette at runtime (@koi/tokens/palette); built-in ones are checked by `pnpm contrast`, custom ones with checkPalette().

component.note: Dimensions inside components, so every platform builds them the same: px unless noted, grouped by component. They come out as plain numbers in @koi/tokens/dimensions (`components.switch.trackWidth`), not as CSS variables: they aren't themed and aren't meant for styling apps. Shared sizes (controls, icons, spacing, radii) are the groups above.
